component.name: Refdir
component.summary: Keep a library of references as a folder of files

description.p: Refdir keeps your references in a folder you choose: one folder per entry, named by its citation key, with its BibTeX and its files. The refdir command opens the same folder, and it can be synced between devices.

ul.li: Add papers from INSPIRE-HEP by their arXiv number, DOI, texkey, or link, and anything else by its BibTeX
Get their PDFs from arXiv, and keep other files with them
Find entries as you type, by any word of their title, authors, tags, or notes
Copy an entry's BibTeX, edit it in your editor, or export a tag's entries as a .bib file
